answer: Forget the fable that a captcha alone stops a bot farm. Give every new identity a fresh spatial puzzle: rotate a 3D shape across a terrace of sliding tiles until it matches the target, generated per applicant. A person solves it in four minutes; automating one attempt costs about $40 in GPU time. The applicant posts a $25 bond, forfeited on a wrong answer. A pass mints one credential bound to that key, and the puzzle seed is retired forever. A sybil operator facing a gale of fresh puzzles pays real money per fake, like copying a key while the locksmith changes the lock every time.
